key_line.detail: Guide moved to $1.122-1.127B from $1.117-1.127B: low end +$5M, top unchanged, midpoint +$2.5M. Nine-month revenue $839.0M implies Q4 $283-288M, below Q3's $295.7M sequentially and ~14-16% y/y against 19% in Q3. Value Added Services +21%, Subscription +14.5%, units 9.8M +8%.

guidance.detail: Effectively a narrowing: revenue low end raised, top held; non-GAAP operating margin narrowed to 26.5-27.5% from 26.5-28.0% (top lowered). Street FY revenue ~$1.12B (stockanalysis, per the hunt) sat at the old midpoint, so the new midpoint is only a hair above the street.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a fourth FY raise from the H2 cushion with Q3 ~1% above $294.2M. Q3 came in +0.5% over that bar and the guide was raised only at the low end with the margin top trimmed; the implied Q4 deceleration is the opposite of the cushion the thesis read. A clear non-GAAP EPS beat (snippet bar) and margin expansion are the offsetting positives.

expected.open_lag_note: No pre-market trades and only a -0.4% after-hours print, so the open is a fresh price discovery in a thin name (8.65 days to cover) and its direction is uncertain; the token raise with a lower margin top and a Q4 deceleration leaves more room down than up, while the EPS beat and margin expansion cap it. Gap is likely under 2%, so the fade question is close to a coin flip.
